description: UCI row 40 (age 30, LOW vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 6, horizon 3yr) — sector equity etf: all hard rules pass, soft fails ['R3'] (score 85) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Pilar Delgado is 30 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 109,800 euros (around 9,150 euros per month). They hold 36,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 3,000 euros with a 3-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 3,000 euros if the investment performs poorly.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund providing concentrated exposure to European technology and digitisation sector companies. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Sector concentration produces higher volatility than diversified equity funds; basic financial knowledge is required. The recommended minimum holding period is five years.
